name: support_r1
source_citation: spec 08 §Constants (rear support distance); spec 08 §Footprint model; safety-model §4.2
measured_rule: union: every check uses both the spec position and the measured position of this support (safety-model §4.3); the spec value is never replaced

name: support_r2
measured_rule: union: every check uses both the spec position and the measured position of this support (safety-model §4.3); the spec value is never replaced

name: support_r3
measured_rule: union: every check uses both the spec position and the measured position of this support (safety-model §4.3); the spec value is never replaced

name: support_delta1
source_citation: spec 08 §Footprint model (q1 = p − 402 · u(θ), on the body axis); safety-model §4.2
measured_rule: union: every check uses both the spec position and the measured position of this support (safety-model §4.3); the spec value is never replaced

name: support_delta2
measured_rule: union: every check uses both the spec position and the measured position of this support (safety-model §4.3); the spec value is never replaced

name: support_delta3
measured_rule: union: every check uses both the spec position and the measured position of this support (safety-model §4.3); the spec value is never replaced

name: heading_offset
note: The physical meaning of C (which way u(θ) points on the robot) is unverified until rung R3; until then the any-heading safe zone applies (safety-model §8).

name: c_grid_step
source_citation: spec 08 §Emitting the C word (multiples of 10 in [0, 350]); safety-model §4.1

name: r_max
formula: max_k r_k over the active footprint model

name: r_min
formula: min_k r_k over the active footprint model

name: support_centroid_distance
source_citation: spec 08 §Footprint model (centroid about 168 mm behind the tool); safety-model §4.6
formula: |c|, c = the mean of the three support offsets d_k(θ)

name: r_rot
formula: ceil(max(R_max, d_c + R_c)), whole millimetres rounded up

name: r_w
source_citation: field guide 04 (wheel contact radius per module); spec 08 §Caveats (what the support points are); safety-model §4.4
measured_rule: the maximum of the three modules' contact radii (the conservative value, recorded as ROBOT_MEASURED with the three readings), never the mean
note: Generous guess until rung R0b; raises the amber UNMEASURED MACHINE PROFILE banner.

name: m_w
source_citation: safety-model §4.4 (the wheel margin of the project design, section 4.5)

name: body_hull_margin
measured_rule: the body hull becomes the convex hull of the wheel discs and the measured outline (body.outline_points when given, else the box from the four extents); R_body is then computed from that hull (safety-model §4.5)
note: Default body hull: the convex hull of the wheel discs grown by 60 mm.

name: wire_attachment
source_citation: field guide 04 (wire attachment); prior-art review §4 (wires tethered to the top of the machine); safety-model §6.4
measured_rule: measured-point: the point at wire.back_mm, wire.right_mm in the body frame (the tool point when wire.attachment is on_spindle_axis); not_found, unknown, or two attachment points (wire.same_point no) keep body-hull and go to design review

name: m_edge
source_citation: safety-model §6.2 (wheel edge margin: edge quality, detection error, positioning near edges unverified)
note: 50 mm until rung R9 has shown positioning near the edges; then 10 mm, owner policy.

name: m_edge_baseline
source_citation: safety-model §6.2; prior-art review §4.1 (accuracy near the tower baseline, an inference there)
note: Kept on the tower-baseline edge until rung R9 has tested that edge.

name: m_tower
note: Rung R9 may lower it.

name: near_square_extra
note: A job with |W − H| <= 2·tol_panel + this value needs the tower-2 axis confirmed at the arming checklist against the photographed placement.

name: r3_park_heading_sweep
source_citation: safety-model §9.5 (only in the design-reviewed R3 exception)

name: tower_zone_leg_tool
source_citation: spec 08 §Tower keep-out zones (the toolpath check); safety-model §5.1

name: tower_base_radius
measured_rule: tower.base_radius_mm replaces the default (ROBOT_MEASURED, the larger tower); it must be at least half the larger of tower.base_length_mm and tower.base_width_mm, otherwise the measurement goes to design review

name: panel_max_side
source_citation: spec README §Key reference constants (max work area); safety-model §6.4

name: reach_max
source_citation: spec README §Key reference constants ('diagonal 3500', read as the wires' usable reach: an inference); prior-art review §4 (4 m wire); safety-model §6.4

name: safe_zone_inset_desk
formula: R_rot + ρ + m_edge + geom_tol: how far the any-heading zone lies inside each side of a rectangular panel at the desk

name: z_safety
source_citation: spec 05 §Semantics a replacement must match (Z_SAFETY_DISTANCE); safety-model §3.2

name: z_upper_limit
source_citation: spec README §Key reference constants (Z travel 58 mm; the +40 mm limit is inferred from it); safety-model §3.2

name: tool_max_diameter
source_citation: spec README §Key reference constants (max bit diameter / length)

name: tool_max_length
source_citation: spec README §Key reference constants (max bit diameter / length); used as the stick-out limit of T-TOOL

name: feed_cap
source_citation: safety-model §11.5 (D-FEED); no source gives a safe feed
note: The owner may lower it; after rung R5 the owner sets the caps.

name: rpm_cap
source_citation: prior-art review §4 (a spindle that maxes out at 27,000 RPM, a press source); safety-model §11.5

name: eps_surf
note: The project design lists it as derived but gives no formula; recorded as a chosen threshold.

name: t_hold
note: Grooves shallower than half the stock hold; typical tabs do not. The relaxation R-TABS can lower it after rung R7.

name: piece_length_max
formula: min(50, floor(min_k r_k − ρ − r_tool − δ_tool − 2·e_max − 1)); the default is the value with the spec footprint, ρ = 55 mm and the largest bit (8 mm)

name: check_chord_tol
source_citation: safety-model §3.5 (largest sagitta of a checked sub-arc)

name: emit_arc_tol
source_citation: safety-model §3.5 (arcs written as G01 while arcs_emit is off)

name: arc_closure_tol
source_citation: gi-format §8.7 (0 < |end − start| < 0.01 mm is ambiguous); safety-model §3.5

name: c_step_max
source_citation: safety-model §9.2 (every emitted step strictly below it)
note: Strictly below 180 the numeric and the shortest-way readings of a C change give the same arc. After rung R3 records rotation.model = in-place-shortest, a single short step across the wrap is allowed.

name: cumulative_rotation_max
source_citation: spec 08 §Emitting the C word (C in [0, 350], the vendor's envelope); safety-model §9.2
note: The wires are tethered to the robot; until rung R0b shows how they attach, the body stays within ±350° of its start heading.

name: kerf_width_max
note: 0 = no kerf may be crossed. Rung R8k measures the value; only measured values open R-KERF.

name: recess_ignore_max
note: 0 = every removal deeper than ε_surf is a wheel keep-out.

name: max_program_bytes
note: 32 KiB until rung R10 records a larger verified size.

name: upload_block
source_citation: spec 03 §Full job flow (step G3); spec README §Key reference constants

name: tank_volume
source_citation: spec 08 §Constants; spec 08 §Extra moves; notice N-DUST only

name: battery_ack_below
source_citation: safety-model §2 (runner rule; thresholds inferred, no discharge rate is known)
note: Any tower WARN blocks; below this level with an estimated job above battery_ack_job_min, a typed acknowledgement is needed.

name: battery_ack_job_min
symbol: job length for the battery rule

name: series_band
source_citation: spec 03 §Full job flow (step D: detection traces the panel edge); safety-model §13

name: panel_width
note: At job time the measured panel replaces it (safety-model §12).

name: stock_thickness
source_citation: safety-model §3.2; gi-format §10 (STOCK t, measured with callipers)

name: tower2_axis
source_citation: safety-model §5.1; gi-format §10 (TOWER2 axis); spec 02 §Tower pairing & geometry

name: tool_stickout
note: Absent: T-TOOL does not check the stick-out, and the report says so.

name: tool_max_stepdown
note: Absent: T-PASS is not evaluated, and the report says so.

name: support_strip_width
note: Absent or 0: no support strip on that side; the vendor's pass-2 overhang is used only onto declared strips.

name: placement_dx
note: Absent: no shift. A shift is applied and disclosed; GI STOCK origin=t1-corner agrees only with no shift.
